title: Four years of secret funding before History Channel
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Four years of secret funding before History Channel, about 2016-2020 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: who I was funding this investigation and keep keeping it completely secret and confidential for 4 years before being persuaded by the History Channel

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, told podcast host Jesse Michels that from about 2016 he paid for a scientific investigation of the ranch himself and kept it completely secret for four years. He says that only after that was he persuaded to let the History Channel, a US television network, film it, and he names Jim Segala and Hal Puthoff in telling the story. It matters to him because it would show the research began as a private, serious effort, not as a TV show.
